parameters.query:
INSERT INTO storici_passaggi (station, played_at, artist, title, normalized_artist, normalized_title)
SELECT '{{ $json.station.replace(/'/g, "''").replace(/\\/g, "\\\\") }}', '{{ $json.played_at }}'::timestamptz, '{{ $json.artist.replace(/'/g, "''").replace(/\\/g, "\\\\") }}', '{{ $json.title.replace(/'/g, "''").replace(/\\/g, "\\\\") }}', '{{ $json.normalized_artist.replace(/'/g, "''").replace(/\\/g, "\\\\") }}', '{{ $json.normalized_title.replace(/'/g, "''").replace(/\\/g, "\\\\") }}'
WHERE '{{ $json.station }}' <> '__skip__'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM storici_passaggi 
    WHERE station = '{{ $json.station.replace(/'/g, "''").replace(/\\/g, "\\\\") }}' 
      AND played_at = '{{ $json.played_at }}'::timestamptz 
      AND normalized_artist = '{{ $json.normalized_artist.replace(/'/g, "''").replace(/\\/g, "\\\\") }}' 
      AND normalized_title = '{{ $json.normalized_title.replace(/'/g, "''").replace(/\\/g, "\\\\") }}'
  )
RETURNING 1 AS inserted;

parameters.jsCode:
// PostgreSQL can output 0, 1, or many rows. The station loop must receive exactly one continuation item.
return [{ json: { continue_station_loop: true } }];

parameters.query:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (normalized_artist, normalized_title) normalized_artist, normalized_title, artist, title
FROM (
  SELECT normalized_artist, normalized_title, artist, title, 1 AS priority FROM storici_passaggi
  UNION ALL
  SELECT normalized_artist, normalized_title, artist, title, 2 AS priority FROM catalogo_toscana
) source
WHERE normalized_artist <> '' AND normalized_title <> ''
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deezer_popolarita d WHERE d.normalized_artist = source.normalized_artist AND d.normalized_title = source.normalized_title AND (d.match_status = 'matched' OR d.updated_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'))
ORDER BY normalized_artist, normalized_title, priority
LIMIT 100;

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().map((item, index) => ({ json: { ...item.json, deezer_query: 'track:"' + item.json.title + '" artist:"' + item.json.artist + '"' }, pairedItem: { item: index } }));

parameters.query:
SELECT s.artist, s.title, s.normalized_artist, s.normalized_title,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.station = 'RDS Relax')::int AS rds_relax_spins,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.station = 'Radio Monte Carlo')::int AS rmc_spins,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.station = 'Dimensione Suono Soft')::int AS ds_soft_spins,
 COALESCE(MAX(d.deezer_popularity), 0)::int AS deezer_popularity,
 COALESCE(MAX(d.deezer_rank), 0)::bigint AS deezer_rank,
 BOOL_OR(c.normalized_artist IS NOT NULL) AS in_catalog,
 MAX(c.category) AS catalog_category,
 COALESCE(MAX(c.spins_total), 0)::int AS catalog_total_spins
FROM storici_passaggi s
LEFT JOIN deezer_popolarita d ON d.normalized_artist = s.normalized_artist AND d.normalized_title = s.normalized_title AND d.match_status = 'matched'
LEFT JOIN catalogo_toscana c ON c.normalized_artist = s.normalized_artist AND c.normalized_title = s.normalized_title
WHERE s.played_at >= date_trunc('day', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Rome') - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY s.artist, s.title, s.normalized_artist, s.normalized_title
ORDER BY rds_relax_spins DESC, rmc_spins DESC, ds_soft_spins DESC;

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { status: 'success', message: 'Catalogo importato correttamente.' } }];
